units.zh: 蕭餘里也耶律合魯蕭得裏特蕭訛都斡蕭達魯古耶律塔不也蕭圖古辭
units.en: Xiao Yulili, Yelü Helu, Xiao Delite, Xiao Eduwo, Xiao Dalugu, Yelü Tabuye, and Xiao Tuguci
units.literal: Xiao Yulili, Yelü Helu, Xiao Delite, Xiao Eduwo, Xiao Dalugu, Yelü Tabuye, Xiao Tuguci

units.zh: 蕭餘里也，字訛都碗，國舅阿剌次子。
units.en: Xiao Yulili, whose style name was Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.
units.literal: Xiao Yulili, style name Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.

units.zh: 便佞滑稽，善女工。
units.en: He was obsequious and facetious, and excelled at needlework and other domestic crafts.
units.literal: Fawning and buffoonish, skilled in women's crafts.

units.zh: 重熙間，以外戚進。
units.en: During the Chongxi era he rose through his ties as an imperial in-law.
units.literal: During Chongxi, he advanced through maternal kinship.

units.zh: 清寧初，補祗候郎君，尚鄭國公主，拜駙馬都尉，累遷南面林牙。
units.en: At the start of Qingning he entered service as an attendant langjun, married the Princess of Zheng State, was made Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant, and was promoted step by step to Southern Court linya.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he was appointed attendant langjun, married the Princess of Zheng State, invested as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant, and rose through posts to Southern Court linya.

units.zh: 以父阿剌為蕭革所譖，出餘里也為奉先軍節度使。
units.en: When his father Ala was slandered by Xiao Ge, Yulili was posted out as military commissioner of the Fengxian Army.
units.literal: Because his father Ala was slandered by Xiao Ge, Yulili was sent out as military commissioner of Fengxian Army.

units.zh: 十年冬，召為北面林牙。
units.en: In the winter of the tenth year he was recalled to serve as Northern Court linya.
units.literal: In the tenth winter, he was summoned as Northern Court linya.

units.zh: 咸雍中，會有告餘里也與族人術哲謀害耶律乙辛，按無狀，出為寧遠軍節度使。
units.en: During Xianyong someone reported that Yulili and his kinsman Shuzhe had plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; the inquiry found nothing, and he was sent out as military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army.
units.literal: During Xianyong, there was a report that Yulili and his clansman Shuzhe plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; investigation found no substance, and he was sent out as military commissioner of Ningyuan Army.

units.zh: 自後餘里也揣乙辛意，傾心事之，薦為國舅詳穩。
units.en: After that Yulili read Yixin's wishes and threw himself into serving him, and was recommended for the post of State Uncle xiangwen.
units.literal: Thereafter Yulili gauged Yixin's intentions and devoted himself wholeheartedly; he was recommended as State Uncle xiangwen.

units.zh: 大康初，封遼西郡王。
units.en: At the start of Dakang he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.

units.zh: 時乙辛擅恣，凡不附己者出之，乃引餘里也為北府宰相，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
units.en: Yixin was then ruling arbitrarily: anyone who would not side with him was posted away. He brought Yulili in as Chancellor of the Northern Prefecture and concurrently put him in charge of Khitan mobile-palace deployments.
units.literal: At the time Yixin acted with unchecked power; whoever did not attach to him was sent away. He then brought in Yulili as Chancellor of the Northern Prefecture and concurrently administrator of Khitan mobile-palace deployments.

units.zh: 及乙辛謀構皇太子，餘里也多助成之，遂知北院樞密事，賜推誠協贊功臣。
units.en: When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support.
units.literal: When Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Yulili greatly helped bring it about; he then administered Northern Court privy affairs and was granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support.

units.zh: 以女侄妻乙辛子綏也，恃勢橫肆，至有無君之語，朝野側目。
units.en: He gave his niece in marriage to Yixin's son Suiye, and, trusting in his power, behaved with brazen arrogance, even uttering words that showed no regard for the sovereign; the court and the realm looked on in dismay.
units.literal: He married his niece to Yixin's son Suiye, relied on his power and acted with reckless arrogance, even speaking words that denied the sovereign; court and countryside watched askance.

units.zh: 帝出乙辛知南院大王事，坐與乙辛黨，以天平軍節度使歸第。
units.en: When the emperor sent Yixin out to administer Southern Court great king affairs, Yulili, as a member of Yixin's faction, was made military commissioner of the Tianping Army and sent home.
units.literal: The emperor sent Yixin out to administer Southern Court great king affairs; because Yulili was of Yixin's faction, he was made military commissioner of Tianping Army and sent home.

units.zh: 尋拜西北路招討使。
units.en: Before long he was appointed Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 以母憂去官，卒。
units.en: He resigned on mourning for his mother and died.
units.literal: He left office on account of his mother's mourning and died.

units.zh: 耶律合魯，字胡都堇，六院舍利古直之後。
units.en: Yelü Helu, whose style name was Hudujin, was descended from the Six-Divisions sheriguzhi.
units.literal: Yelü Helu, style name Hudujin, was a descendant of the Six-Divisions sheriguzhi.

units.zh: 柔佞喜茍合。
units.en: He was pliant and sycophantic, and eager to curry favor by any means.
units.literal: Soft, fawning, fond of unprincipled compliance.

units.zh: 仕清寧初。
units.en: He entered office at the start of Qingning.
units.literal: He entered service at the beginning of Qingning.

units.zh: 時乙辛引用群小，合魯附之，遂見委任，俄擢南面林牙。
units.en: As Yixin was promoting petty followers, Helu attached himself to him, won his trust, and was soon raised to Southern Court linya.
units.literal: When Yixin was promoting petty men, Helu attached himself and won trust; soon he was promoted to Southern Court linya.

units.zh: 乙辛譖皇太子，殺忠直，合魯多預其謀。
units.en: When Yixin slandered the crown prince and killed the loyal and upright, Helu took part in many of his schemes.
units.literal: When Yixin slandered the crown prince and killed the loyal and upright, Helu took part in many of his plots.

units.zh: 弟吾也亦黨乙辛，時號「二賊」。
units.en: His younger brother Wuye also sided with Yixin; people at the time called them "the two villains."
units.literal: His younger brother Wuye also joined Yixin's faction; at the time they were called "the two villains."

units.zh: 乙辛薦為北院大王，卒。
units.en: Yixin recommended him as Northern Court great king, and he died in that office.
units.literal: Yixin recommended him as Northern Court great king; he died.

units.zh: 吾也亦至南院大王。
units.en: Wuye likewise rose to Southern Court great king.
units.literal: Wuye also rose to Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 蕭得裏特，遙輦窪可汗宮分人。
units.en: Xiao Delite belonged to the palace division of Yaolian Khan Wokohan.
units.literal: Xiao Delite was a member of the palace division of Yaolian Khan Wokohan.

units.zh: 善阿意順色。
units.en: He was adept at flattery and at reading others' expressions.
units.literal: Skilled at fawning and matching others' moods.

units.zh: 清寧初，乙辛用事，甚見引用，累遷北面林牙、同知北院宣徽使事。
units.en: At the start of Qingning, when Yixin was in power, Delite was heavily used and rose through Northern Court linya to associate administrator of Northern Court Xuanhui commissioner affairs.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, when Yixin held power, Delite was greatly employed, successively rising to Northern Court linya and associate administrator of Northern Court Xuanhui commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 及皇太子廢，遣得裏特監送上京。
units.en: When the crown prince was deposed, Delite was sent to supervise his transfer to the Upper Capital.
units.literal: When the crown prince was deposed, Delite was dispatched to supervise escort to the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 得裏特促其行，不令下車，起居飲食數加陵侮，至則築圜堵囚之。
units.en: Delite hurried the journey along, would not let him step down from the cart, and repeatedly humiliated him in his daily needs and meals; on arrival he built a round earthen enclosure and imprisoned him there.
units.literal: Delite hastened the journey, would not let him alight from the cart, repeatedly insulted him in daily needs and meals, and on arrival built a round earthen wall to imprison him.

units.zh: 大康中，遷西南招討使，歷順義軍節度使，轉國舅詳穩。
units.en: During Dakang he was transferred to Southwest pacification commissioner, served as military commissioner of the Shunyi Army, and then became State Uncle xiangwen.
units.literal: In Dakang he was moved to Southwest pacification commissioner, served as Shunyi Army military commissioner, then transferred to State Uncle xiangwen.

units.zh: 壽隆五年，坐怨望，以老免死，闔門籍興聖宮，貶西北統軍司，卒。
units.en: In the fifth year of Shoulong he was charged with resentment and complaint; because of his age he was spared execution, his entire household was registered to Xingsheng Palace, and he was demoted to the Northwest Military Control Office, where he died.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong, for resentment and complaint, he was spared death on account of age; his whole household was registered to Xingsheng Palace and he was demoted to Northwest Military Control Office; he died.

units.zh: 二子：得末、訛裏，乾統間以父與乙辛謀，伏誅。
units.en: He had two sons, Demo and Eoli; during Qiantong, because their father had plotted with Yixin, both were executed.
units.literal: Two sons: Demo and Eoli; during Qiantong, because their father had plotted with Yixin, they were executed.

units.zh: 蕭訛都斡，國舅少父房之後。
units.en: Xiao Eduwo was descended from the State Uncle Shaofu branch.
units.literal: Xiao Eduwo was a descendant of the State Uncle Shaofu branch.

units.zh: 咸雍中，補牌印郎君。
units.en: During Xianyong he was appointed seal-and-tally langjun.
units.literal: During Xianyong he was appointed seal-and-tally langjun.

units.zh: 大康三年，樞密使乙辛陰懷逆謀，乃令護衛太保耶律查剌誣告耶律撒剌等廢立事。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang, Privy Commissioner Yixin secretly harbored treasonous intent and had Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Zhala falsely accuse Yelü Sala and others of plotting to depose the emperor and install another.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, Privy Commissioner Yixin secretly harbored treasonous designs and had Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Zhala falsely accuse Yelü Sala and others of plotting deposition and installation.

units.zh: 詔按無狀，皆補外。
units.en: An edict ordered an inquiry; when nothing was found, all were posted to offices outside the capital.
units.literal: An edict ordered investigation; finding no substance, all were assigned to outer posts.

units.zh: 頃之，訛都斡希乙辛意，欲實其事，與耶律塔不也等入闕誣首：「耶律撒剌等謀害乙辛，欲立皇太子事，臣亦預謀。
units.en: Before long Eduwo divined Yixin's intent and, wanting to make the accusation stick, entered the palace with Yelü Tabuye and others to make a false confession: "Yelü Sala and the others plotted to kill Yixin and put the crown prince on the throne; I too was in on the plot.
units.literal: Before long Eduwo guessed Yixin's wish and, wishing to make the charge real, entered the palace with Yelü Tabuye and others to confess falsely: "Yelü Sala and others plotted to kill Yixin and install the crown prince; I too took part in the plot.

units.zh: 今不自言，恐事泄連坐。」
units.en: If I do not speak up now, I fear that when the matter comes out I will be punished along with the rest."
units.literal: If I do not speak now, I fear that when the affair leaks out I will be implicated."

units.zh: 帝果怒，徙皇太子於上京。
units.en: The emperor was indeed enraged and transferred the crown prince to the Upper Capital.
units.literal: The emperor was indeed enraged and moved the crown prince to the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，為駙馬都尉。
units.en: Eduwo married the imperial daughter, Princess of Zhao State, and was made Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.
units.literal: Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao State and served as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.

units.zh: 後與乙辛議不合，銜之，復以車服僭擬人主，被誅。
units.en: Later he disagreed with Yixin and nursed a grievance; he was again executed for carriages and regalia that imitated the sovereign's.
units.literal: Later he fell out with Yixin over policy and bore a grudge; again, for carriages and regalia that usurped the sovereign's, he was executed.

units.zh: 訛都斡臨刑，語人曰：「前告耶律撒刺事，皆乙辛教我。
units.en: As Eduwo faced execution he told those present: "The earlier charge against Yelü Sala—Yixin taught me every word of it.
units.literal: At execution Eduwo told others: "The earlier accusation against Yelü Sala—Yixin taught me all of it.

units.zh: 恐事彰，殺我以滅口耳！」
units.en: He is afraid the truth will come out, so he kills me to seal my lips!"
units.literal: Fearing the affair would be exposed, he kills me to silence me!"

units.zh: 蕭達魯古，遙輦嘲古可汗宮分人。
units.en: Xiao Dalugu belonged to the palace division of Yaolian Khan Chaogukohan.
units.literal: Xiao Dalugu was a member of the palace division of Yaolian Khan Chaogukohan.

units.zh: 性奸險。
units.en: By nature he was treacherous and ruthless.
units.literal: In nature he was treacherous and dangerous.

units.zh: 清寧間，乙辛為樞密使，竊權用事，陰懷逆謀。
units.en: During Qingning, when Yixin was privy commissioner, he seized power and ruled arbitrarily while secretly plotting treason.
units.literal: During Qingning, when Yixin served as privy commissioner, he usurped power and acted arbitrarily while secretly harboring treasonous designs.

units.zh: 達魯古比附之，遂見獎拔，稍遷至旗鼓拽剌詳穩。
units.en: Dalugu attached himself to Yixin, won favor and promotion, and was gradually raised to xiangwen of the Qigu zhuala banner.
units.literal: Dalugu attached himself to Yixin, won promotion, and was gradually advanced to xiangwen of the Qigu zhuala banner.

units.zh: 乙辛欲害太子，以達魯古凶果可使，遣與近侍直長撒把詣上京，同留守蕭撻得夜引力士至囚室，紿以有赦，召太子出，殺之，函其首以歸，詐云疾薨。
units.en: When Yixin wished to kill the crown prince, he judged Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he sent him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, called him out and killed him, boxed his head and returned, and falsely reported that he had died of sudden illness.
units.literal: Wanting to harm the crown prince, Yixin deemed Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he dispatched him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, summoned him out, killed him, boxed his head and returned, falsely reporting that he had died of sudden illness.

units.zh: 以達魯古為國舅詳穩。
units.en: Dalugu was made State Uncle xiangwen.
units.literal: Dalugu was appointed State Uncle xiangwen.

units.zh: 達魯古恐殺太子事白，出入常佩刀，有急召即欲自殺。
units.en: Dalugu feared that the murder of the crown prince would come to light; he always carried a knife when he went in and out, and if urgently summoned he intended to kill himself.
units.literal: Dalugu feared that the affair of killing the crown prince would be exposed; he constantly carried a knife when going in and out, and if urgently summoned intended to kill himself.

units.zh: 乾統間，詔樞密使耶律阿思大索乙辛黨人，達魯古以賂獲免。
units.en: During Qiantong, when an edict ordered Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi to conduct a sweeping purge of Yixin's faction, Dalugu bought his way free.
units.literal: During Qiantong, an edict had Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi conduct a sweeping search for Yixin's partisans; Dalugu escaped through bribery.

units.zh: 後以疾卒。
units.en: Later he died of illness.
units.literal: Later he died of illness.

units.zh: 耶律塔不也，仲父房之後。
units.en: Yelü Tabuye was descended from the Zhongfu branch.
units.literal: Yelü Tabuye was a descendant of the Zhongfu branch.

units.zh: 以善擊鞠幸於上，凡馳騁，鞠不離杖。
units.en: Because he excelled at cuju he won the emperor's favor; whenever he rode at full speed, the ball never left his stick.
units.literal: Because he excelled at cuju he won the sovereign's favor; whenever he galloped, the ball never left his mallet.

units.zh: 咸雍初，補祗候郎君。
units.en: At the start of Xianyong he was appointed attendant langjun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he was appointed attendant langjun.

units.zh: 與耶律乙辛善，故內外畏之。
units.en: He was on good terms with Yelü Yixin, and for that reason everyone at court feared him.
units.literal: Friendly with Yelü Yixin, so inside and outside the court feared him.

units.zh: 及太子被譖，按無跡，塔不也附乙辛，欲實其誣，與訛都斡等密奏：「太子謀亂事本實，臣不首，恐事覺連坐。」
units.en: When the crown prince was slandered and the inquiry found nothing, Tabuye sided with Yixin to make the charge stick; with Eduwo and others he secretly memorialized: "The crown prince's plot of rebellion was real; if I do not come forward first, I fear that when it is discovered I will be punished with the rest."
units.literal: When the crown prince was slandered and investigation found no trace, Tabuye attached himself to Yixin to make the slander real; with Eduwo and others he secretly memorialized: "The crown prince's plot of rebellion was real; if I do not confess first, I fear discovery will implicate me."

units.zh: 帝信之，廢太子。
units.en: The emperor believed them and deposed the crown prince.
units.literal: The emperor believed it and deposed the crown prince.

units.zh: 改延慶宮副使。
units.en: He was reassigned as deputy commissioner of Yanqing Palace.
units.literal: He was changed to deputy commissioner of Yanqing Palace.

units.zh: 壽隆元年，為行宮都部署。
units.en: In the first year of Shoulong he became mobile-palace chief deployer.
units.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, he was made mobile-palace chief deployer.

units.zh: 天祚嗣位，以塔不也黨乙辛，出為特免部節度使。
units.en: When Tianzu succeeded to the throne, Tabuye, as a partisan of Yixin, was posted out as military commissioner of the Tejian tribe.
units.literal: When Tianzu succeeded, because Tabuye was of Yixin's faction, he was sent out as Tejian tribe military commissioner.

units.zh: 及樞密使耶律阿思大索乙辛舊黨，塔不也以賂獲免。
units.en: When Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi launched a sweeping purge of Yixin's old faction, Tabuye bought his way free.
units.literal: When Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi broadly hunted old Yixin partisans, Tabuye escaped through bribery.

units.zh: 徙敵烈部節度使，復為敦睦宮使。
units.en: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Dilie tribe, then restored as commissioner of Dunmu Palace.
units.literal: He was transferred as Dilie tribe military commissioner, then restored as Dunmu Palace commissioner.

units.zh: 天慶元年，出為西北路招討使。
units.en: In the first year of Tianqing he was posted out as Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianqing, he was sent out as Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 以疾卒。
units.en: He died of illness.
units.literal: He died of illness.

units.zh: 蕭圖古辭，字何寧，楮特部人。
units.en: Xiao Tuguci, whose style name was Hening, was a man of the Zhute tribe.
units.literal: Xiao Tuguci, style name Hening, was of the Zhute tribe.

units.zh: 仕重熙中，以能稱，累遷左中丞。
units.en: He served during Chongxi, won renown for his ability, and was promoted step by step to Left Vice Censor.
units.literal: He served in Chongxi, was famed for ability, and rose through posts to Left Vice Censor.

units.zh: 清寧初，歷北面林牙，改北院樞密副使。
units.en: At the start of Qingning he served as Northern Court linya, then became associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he served as Northern Court linya, then changed to associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 辨敏，善伺顏色，應對合上意。
units.en: He was quick and perceptive, skilled at reading the emperor's mood, and his replies always suited the sovereign's wishes.
units.literal: Sharp-witted, skilled at reading expressions; his replies matched the sovereign's mind.

units.zh: 皇太后嘗曰：「有大事，非耶律化哥、蕭圖古辭不能決。」
units.en: The empress dowager once said, "For any great matter, nothing can be decided without Yelü Huage and Xiao Tuguci."
units.literal: The empress dowager once said: "For great affairs, nothing can be settled without Yelü Huage and Xiao Tuguci."

units.zh: 眷遇日隆。
units.en: His favor grew greater day by day.
units.literal: His favor day by day grew.

units.zh: 知北院樞密使事。
units.en: He was put in charge of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.
units.literal: He administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 六年，出知黃龍府。
units.en: In the sixth year he was sent out to administer Huanglong Prefecture.
units.literal: In the sixth year, he was sent out to administer Huanglong Prefecture.

units.zh: 八年，拜南府宰相。
units.en: In the eighth year he was made Chancellor of the Southern Prefecture.
units.literal: In the eighth year, he was invested as Chancellor of the Southern Prefecture.

units.zh: 頃之，為北院樞密使，詔許便宜從事。
units.en: Before long he became Northern Court privy commissioner, and an edict allowed him to act at his own discretion.
units.literal: Before long he was made Northern Court privy commissioner; an edict permitted discretionary action.

units.zh: 為人奸佞有餘，好聚斂，專愎，變更法度。
units.en: In character he was surpassingly treacherous and fawning, greedy for gain, wilfully obstinate, and given to changing laws and institutions.
units.literal: As a man he was abundantly treacherous and fawning, fond of extortion, wilfully obstinate, and altered laws and institutions.

units.zh: 為樞密數月，所薦引多為重元黨與，由是免為庶人。
units.en: After only a few months as privy commissioner, most of those he recommended proved to be partisans of Chongyuan; for this he was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
units.literal: As privy commissioner for several months, most he recommended were Chongyuan's partisans; thereby he was demoted to commoner.

units.zh: 後沒入興聖宮，卒。
units.en: Later his property was confiscated to Xingsheng Palace, and he died.
units.literal: Later he was confiscated to Xingsheng Palace; he died.

units.zh: 論曰：舜流共工，孔子誅少正卯，治奸之法嚴矣。
units.en: The commentary says: Shun exiled Gong Gong, and Confucius executed Shaozheng Mao—the standards for dealing with traitors were severe indeed.
units.literal: Commentary says: Shun exiled Gong Gong, Confucius executed Shaozheng Mao—the law for governing traitors was stern indeed.

units.zh: 後世不是之察，反以為忠而信任之，不至於流毒宗社而未已。
units.en: Later ages lacked such discernment and instead took traitors for loyal men and trusted them, not stopping until their poison had spread through the altars of state.
units.literal: Later ages lacked such discernment and instead took them for loyal men and trusted them, not stopping until poison spread through altars and state.

units.zh: 道宗之於乙辛是也。
units.en: Emperor Daozong's treatment of Yixin was exactly such a case.
units.literal: Emperor Daozong's treatment of Yixin was exactly this.

units.zh: 當其留仁先，討重元，若真為國計者；
units.en: When he kept Yelü Renxian at court and campaigned against Chongyuan, it looked as though he truly had the state's interests at heart;
units.literal: When he kept Renxian and campaigned against Chongyuan, it seemed as if he truly acted for the state;

units.zh: 不知包藏禍心，待時而發耳。
units.en: who could have known that he was hiding a treacherous heart and biding his time to strike.
units.literal: not knowing he harbored a treacherous heart and waited for the moment to strike.

units.zh: 一旦專權，又得孝傑、燕哥、十三為之腹心，故肆惡而無忌憚。
units.en: Once he held power alone and had Zhang Xiaojie, Yelü Yange, and Xiao Shisan as his inner circle, he therefore committed evil without restraint or fear.
units.literal: Once he monopolized power and gained Xiaojie, Yange, and Shisan as his inner core, he therefore unleashed evil without restraint.

units.zh: 始誣皇后，又殺太子及其妃，其禍之酷，良可悲哉。
units.en: First he slandered the empress, then killed the crown prince and his consort—the cruelty of the harm he wrought is truly lamentable.
units.literal: First he slandered the empress, then killed the crown prince and his consort—the cruelty of the disaster is truly lamentable.

units.zh: 嗚呼！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 君子所親，莫皇后、太子若也。
units.en: Among those whom a gentleman holds dear, none compare with the empress and the crown prince.
units.literal: Among those a gentleman cherishes, none are like the empress and crown prince.

units.zh: 奸臣殺之而不知，群臣言之而不悟。
units.en: Treacherous ministers killed them, yet he did not know; the assembled ministers spoke out, yet he did not understand.
units.literal: Treacherous ministers killed them yet he did not know; the assembled ministers spoke yet he did not awaken.

units.zh: 一時忠讜，廢戮幾盡。
units.en: For a time the loyal and outspoken were nearly all destroyed or put to death.
units.literal: For a time the loyal and outspoken were nearly all destroyed and executed.

units.zh: 雖黑山親見官屬之盛，僅削一字王號，至私藏甲兵然後誅之。
units.en: Even when at Black Mountain the emperor personally saw the grandeur of Yixin's retinue, only one character was struck from his princely title; not until he was found secretly hoarding armor and weapons was he put to death.
units.literal: Even when at Black Mountain he personally witnessed the splendor of his staff, only a single character was cut from his princely title; not until he secretly hoarded armor and weapons was he executed.

units.zh: 籲！
units.en: Ah!
units.literal: Ah!

units.zh: 乙辛之罪，固非一死可謝天下，抑亦道宗不明無斷有以養成之也。
units.en: Yixin's crimes truly could not be answered by death alone; yet it was also Daozong's dimness and want of resolution that had nurtured them.
units.literal: Yixin's crimes truly could not be expiated by death alone; yet also Daozong's dimness and lack of resolution nurtured them.

units.zh: 如蕭餘里也輩，忘君黨惡，以饕富貴，雖幸而死諸牖下，其得免於遺臭之辱哉！
units.en: Men such as Xiao Yulili forgot their sovereign and sided with evil to gorge themselves on wealth and rank; though fortunate enough to die in their own homes, how could they escape the shame of a name that stinks forever!
units.literal: Men like Xiao Yulili forgot their lord and sided with evil to gorge on wealth and rank; though fortunate to die in their own houses, how could they escape the shame of a stinking legacy!

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 道宗之孫，父順宗大孝順聖皇帝，母貞順皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.
units.literal: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.

units.zh: 甲辰，上皇考昭懷太子曰大孝順聖皇帝，廟號順宗，皇妣曰貞順皇后。
units.en: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.
units.literal: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，以知北院樞密使事耶律宜新為中京留守，南院宣徽使耶律撒剌為南院大王。
units.en: On xinwei day of the twelfth month Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala was made Southern Court great king.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinwei day Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 癸未，殺始平軍節度使撒剌等十人，又遣使殺上京留守速撒，及已徙護衛撒撥等六人。
units.en: On guimao day ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala were killed; envoys were also dispatched to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.
units.literal: On guimao day killed ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala; also dispatched envoys to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.

units.zh: 戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
units.en: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
units.literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

units.zh: 放勛、重華之世，咸無意於受終，當塗、典午之君，雖有心於揖讓，皆以英才處萬乘，高勳御四海，故能大庇黔首，光宅區縣。
units.en: Yao and Shun took the throne without seeking it; the rulers of Wei and Jin, though they spoke of abdication, still set men of rare talent upon the throne and men of towering merit at the helm of the realm—thus they sheltered the people and brought order to the land.
units.literal: In the ages of Fangxun and Chonghua, both were without intent to receive the end; the lords of Dangtu and Dianwu, though they had mind for yielding, all alike placed men of outstanding talent upon the ten-thousand chariots, with high merit steering the four seas—therefore they could greatly shelter the black-haired people and brightly settle the districts and counties.

units.zh: 既而煙雲表色，日月呈瑞，緯聚東井，龍見譙邦，除舊布新，既彰玄象，遷虞事夏，且協謳訟，[2]九域八荒，同布衷款，百神群祀，皆有誠願。
units.en: Then clouds and mist took auspicious hues; sun and moon showed signs; stars clustered at the Eastern Well; a dragon was seen in Qiao. The old order gave way to the new, and Heaven's signs were plain; as in the transfer from Shun to Yu, the people's acclaim agreed. [2] Within the nine provinces and beyond the eight directions, loyal petitions poured in; every spirit and rite was offered in earnest devotion.
units.literal: Thereafter clouds and mist showed color; sun and moon presented omens; constellations gathered at the Eastern Well; a dragon appeared in the Qiao region. Removing the old and spreading the new, the dark signs were already manifest; shifting from Yu and serving Xia, and moreover matching the songs of praise, [2] the nine domains and eight wilds alike spread forth sincere petitions; the hundred spirits and assembled sacrifices all had sincere wish.

units.zh: 梁氏以天祿斯改，期運永終，欽若唐、虞，推其鼎玉，朕東西退讓，拜手陳辭，避舜子於箕山之陽，求支伯於滄洲之野，而公卿敦逼，率土翹惶，天命難稽，遂享嘉祚。
units.en: The House of Liang, its mandate spent, its turn complete—like Tang and Yu they offered up the regalia. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and pleaded our case, hiding like Shun's son on Mount Ji's sunny slope, seeking Zhibo on Cangzhou's wilds—but ministers pressed us and the realm looked up in dread. Heaven's mandate would not wait; thus We received the glorious throne.
units.literal: The House of Liang, its heavenly blessing now changed, its allotted span ended forever—reverently in accord with Tang and Yu, they pushed forth their tripod and jade. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and spoke our plea, avoiding Shun's son on the sunny slope of Mount Ji, seeking Zhibo on the wilds of Cangzhou—but the dukes and ministers pressed urgently; the whole land looked up in alarm. Heaven's mandate could not be delayed; thus We received the fine fortune.

units.zh: 六月己卯朔，耶律乙辛令牌印郎君蕭訛都斡誣首嘗預速撒等謀，籍其姓名以告。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jimao new moon, Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.

units.zh: 秋七月辛亥，護衛太保查剌加鎮國大將軍，預突呂不部節度使之選，室韋查剌及蕭寶神奴、謀魯古並加左衛大將軍，牌印郎君訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，授駙馬都尉、始平軍節度使，祗候郎君耶律撻不也及蕭圖古辭並加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, was appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.

units.zh: 如耶律撻不也、蕭達魯古等，黨人之尤凶狡者，皆以賂免。
units.en: Men such as Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Dalugu, the faction's most vicious members, all bought their way free.
units.literal: Such men as Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Dalugu — the most vicious and cunning of the faction — all escaped through bribery.

units.zh: 至二年，始廢乙辛等墓，剖棺戮屍，誅其子孫，餘黨子孫減死，徙邊，其家屬奴婢皆分賜被害之家。
units.en: In the second year Yixin's tomb was destroyed, his coffin opened and corpse flogged, his descendants executed; other faction members' descendants had sentences reduced and were exiled, their families and slaves given to the victims' kin.
units.literal: By the second year, Yixin's tomb and others were at last destroyed, coffins opened and corpses flogged, his descendants executed; descendants of the remaining faction had death reduced and were moved to the border; their household members and slaves were all distributed as gifts to the families of the victims.

units.zh: 耶律乙不哥，字習撚，六院郎君古直之後。
units.en: Yelü Yibuge, courtesy name Xinian, was a descendant of Langjun Guzhi of the Six Tribes.
units.literal: Yelü Yibuge, courtesy name Xinian, a descendant of the Langjun Guzhi of the Six Tribes.

units.zh: 甲申，詔北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛同母兄大奴、同母弟阿思世預北、南院樞密之選，其異母諸弟世預夷離堇之選。
units.en: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
units.literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 共工
units.en: Gong Gong
units.literal: Gong Gong

units.zh: 乙亥，北院樞密使耶律乙辛奏，右護衛太保查剌等告知北院樞密使事蕭速撒等八人謀立皇太子，上以無狀，不治，出速撒等三人補外，護衛撒撥等六人各鞭百餘，徙於邊。
units.en: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.
units.literal: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.

units.zh: 耶律韓八 耶律唐古 蕭朮哲
units.en: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, and Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 蕭朮哲
units.en: Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 蕭朮哲，字石魯隱，孝穆弟高九之子。
units.en: Xiao Paizhe, style name Shiluyin, was the son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe, whose style name was Shiluyin, was son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.

units.zh: 蒲奴裏部長陶得裏叛，朮哲為統軍都監，從都統耶律義先擊之，擒陶得裏。
units.en: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as army superintendent and followed the commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian in the attack, capturing Taodeli.
units.literal: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as Army Superintendent and followed Commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian to attack, capturing Taodeli.

units.zh: 唐古、術哲經略西北邊，勸農積粟，訓練士卒，敵人不敢犯。
units.en: Tanggu and Paizhe administered the northwestern frontier, promoted farming and accumulated grain, trained the troops, and the enemy did not dare attack.
units.literal: Tanggu and Paizhe managed the northwestern border, urged farming and stored grain, trained soldiers, and the enemy did not dare offend.

units.zh: 以戚屬加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: By virtue of imperial kinship he was made general of the Gate Guards.
units.literal: By imperial kinship he was made General of the Gate Guards.

units.zh: 重熙十三年，將衛兵討李元昊有功，遷興聖宮使。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led the guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to director of the Xingsheng Palace.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to Director of the Xingsheng Palace.

units.zh: 清寧初，為國舅詳穩、西北路招討使，私取官粟三百斛，及代，留畜產，令主者鬻之以償。
units.en: Early in Qingning he was imperial uncle Details Steady and northwest pacification commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.
units.literal: Early in Qingning he was Imperial Uncle Details Steady and Northwest Pacification Commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.

units.zh: 咸雍二年，拜北府宰相，為北院樞密使耶律乙辛所忌，誣朮哲與護衛蕭忽古等謀害乙辛。
units.en: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed northern chancellery chancellor; Yelu Yixin, northern court privy commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with the guardsman Xiao Hugu and others to harm Yixin.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor; Yelu Yixin, Northern Court Privy Commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with guardsman Xiao Hugu to harm Yixin.

units.zh: 侄藥師奴。
units.en: His nephew was Yaoshinu.
units.literal: Nephew Yaoshinu.

units.zh: 後族弟胡睹到部發其事，帝怒，決以大杖，免官。
units.en: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was enraged, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.
units.literal: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was angry, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.

units.zh: 朮哲與義先不協，誣義先罪，免官。
units.en: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of a crime, and had him removed from office.
units.literal: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of crime, and had him removed from office.

units.zh: 稍遷西南面招討都監，坐事下獄，以太后言，杖而釋之。
units.en: He was gradually promoted to southwest pacification superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Southwest Pacification Superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.

units.zh: 尋起為昭德軍節度使，徵為北院宣徽使。
units.en: Soon he was reappointed military commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as northern court palace commissioner.
units.literal: Soon he was reappointed Military Commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as Northern Court Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 九年，上以朮哲先為招討，威行諸部，復為西北路招討使。
units.en: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made northwest pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made Northwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 訓士卒，增器械，省追呼，嚴號令。
units.en: He trained the soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.
units.literal: He trained soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.

units.zh: 人不敢犯，邊境晏然。
units.en: No one dared offend him, and the border was tranquil.
units.literal: No one dared offend him; the border was tranquil.

units.zh: 十年，入朝，封柳城郡王。
units.en: In the tenth year he came to court and was enfeoffed as prince of Liucheng commandery.
units.literal: In the tenth year he entered court and was enfeoffed Prince of Liucheng commandery.

units.zh: 詔獄無狀，罷相，出鎮順義軍。
units.en: An imperial investigation found no substance to the charge; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.
units.literal: Imperial investigation found no substance; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.

units.zh: 卒，追王晉、宋、梁三國。
units.en: On his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.
units.literal: On death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.

units.zh: 丁未，冊皇后蕭氏，封其父祗候郎君鱉裏剌為趙王，叔西北路招討使餘里也遼西郡王，兄漢人行宮都部署、駙馬都慰霞抹柳城郡王，參知政事楊遵勖知南院樞密使事，北院樞密使副蕭速撒知北院樞密使事，漢人行宮副部署劉詵參知政事。
units.en: On dingwei day Empress Xiao was invested; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: On dingwei day invested Empress Xiao; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 丙子，以西北路招討使遼西郡王蕭餘里也為北府宰相，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
units.en: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
units.literal: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

units.zh: 即命乙辛及耶律仲禧、蕭餘里也、耶律孝傑、楊遵勖、燕哥、抄只、蕭十三等鞫治，杖皇太子，囚之宮中。
units.en: Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others were immediately ordered to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.
units.literal: Immediately ordered Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.

units.zh: 閏十二月戊午，以北府宰相遼西郡王蕭餘里也知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律燕哥為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: In the intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
units.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

units.zh: 甲子，北府宰相蕭惠為北院樞密使，豳王遂哥為惕隱，惕隱敵魯古封漆水郡王、西北路招討使，樞密副使蕭阿剌同知北院宣徽事。
units.en: On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.
units.literal: On jiazi day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui Northern Court Privy Commissioner, Prince of Bin Suige tiyin, enfeoffed tiyin Dirugu as Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner, and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。
units.en: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
units.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

units.zh: 十四年春正月庚申，以侍中蕭虛烈為南院統軍使，封遼西郡王。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on gengshen day of the first spring month, Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie was appointed Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed Prince of Liaoxi.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on gengshen day, made Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed him Prince of Liaoxi.

units.zh: 甲辰，以同知北院宣徽事蕭阿剌為北府宰相。
units.en: On jiachen day concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: On jiachen day, made concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 六月戊寅朔，以蕭寧、耶律坦、崔禹稱、馬世良、耶律仁先、劉六符充賀宋生辰使副；
units.en: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;
units.literal: Sixth month, on the wuyin new moon, appointed Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;

units.zh: 辛卯，仁先、劉六符還，進宋國誓書。
units.en: On xinmao day Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.
units.literal: On xinmao day, Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.

units.zh: 十年春正月辛亥朔，宋遣梁適、張從一、富弼、趙日宣來賀。
units.en: In the tenth year, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month Song sent Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan with congratulations.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the xinhai new moon, Song dispatched Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan to come congratulate.

units.zh: 十一年春正月戊申，奉迎皇太后於內殿。
units.en: In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall.
units.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, escorted the Empress Dowager into the inner hall.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，遣北院樞密副使耶律仁先、漢人行宮副部署劉六符使宋約和。
units.en: On renyin day of the ninth month Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.
units.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, dispatched Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.

units.zh: 閏月癸未，耶律仁先遣人報，宋歲增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，文書稱貢，送至白溝；
units.en: On guiwei day of the intercalary month Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, and it was delivered to Baigou;
units.literal: Intercalary month, on guiwei day, Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, delivered to Baigou;

units.zh: 壬申，以吳國王蕭孝穆為南院樞密使，北府宰相蕭孝忠北院樞密使，封楚王，韓國王蕭惠北府宰相、同知元帥府事，韓八南院大王，耶律侯哂東京留守，北院樞密副使耶律仁先同知東京留守事，北面林牙蕭革北院樞密副使。
units.en: On renshen day Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner; Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu; Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters; Han Ba was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Houshen was appointed Eastern Capital regent; Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian was made co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs; and Northern Court linya Xiao Ge was appointed Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
units.literal: On renshen day, made Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Southern Privy Commissioner, Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, Prince of Han Xiao Hui Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters, Han Ba Southern Court great king, Yelü Houshen Eastern Capital regent, Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs, Northern Court linya Xiao Ge Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

units.zh: 是年，禦清涼殿放進士張孝傑等四十四人。
units.en: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.
units.literal: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.

units.zh: 乙辛尋遣達魯古、撒八往害之，太子年方二十，上京留守蕭撻得紿以疾薨聞。
units.en: Yixin soon sent Dalugu and Saba to kill him. The crown prince was only twenty; Upper Capital regent Xiao Tade was tricked with a report that he had died of illness.
units.literal: Yixin soon sent Dalugu and Saba to go and harm him; the crown prince was only twenty years old; the Upper Capital regent Xiao Tade was deceived with a report that he had died of illness.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛謀害太子，撻不也知其奸，欲殺乙辛及蕭特裏得、蕭十三等。
units.en: When Yelu Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Tabuye saw through his treachery and meant to kill Yixin along with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and their faction.
units.literal: Yelu Yixin plotted to harm the Crown Prince; Tabuye knew his treachery and wished to kill Yixin together with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and others.

units.zh: 大康三年，復欲殺乙辛及蕭得裏特等，乙辛知而械系之。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang he again plotted to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite; Yixin learned of it and had him arrested in fetters.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he again wished to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite and others; Yixin learned of it and had him shackled and bound.

units.zh: 如蕭得裏特實乙辛之黨，耶律合魯亦不為早辨，賴陛下之明，遂正其事。
units.en: Xiao Delite was truly of Yixin's party, and Yelu Helu failed to expose this in time; only Your Majesty's discernment set the matter right.
units.literal: For example, Xiao Delite was in truth of Yixin's faction, and Yelu Helu also did not distinguish the matter early; relying on Your Majesty's clarity, the affair was then set right.

units.zh: 天祚即位，召為御史中丞。
units.en: When Emperor Tianzuo acceded he was recalled as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: When Tianzuo took the throne, he was summoned as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰，以知北院樞密使事蕭圖古辭為北院樞密使。
units.en: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 辛亥，宋以即位，遣陳襄來報，即遣知黃龍府事蕭圖古辭、中書舍人馬鉉往賀。
units.en: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Xiao Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.
units.literal: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Xiao Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.

units.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.en: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 北院大王曷魯。南院大王吾也。
units.en: Helu, Northern Chancellery Great King. Wuye, Southern Chancellery Great King.
units.literal: Northern Chancellery Great King Helu. Southern Chancellery Great King Wuye.

units.zh: 右係出懿祖莊敬皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Yizu the Reverent and Respectful.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Yizu the Reverent and Respectful.

units.zh: 及聞皇太子被害，不勝哀痛，以詩傷之，作《放懷詩》二十首。
units.en: When he heard that the crown prince had been murdered he was overcome with grief; he mourned him in verse and composed twenty poems entitled Poems of Letting Go the Heart.
units.literal: When he heard that the crown prince had been murdered he could not overcome his grief; he mourned him in verse and composed twenty poems entitled "Poems of Letting Go the Heart."

units.zh: 明年，流保州。
units.en: The following year he was exiled to Baozhou.
units.literal: The next year he was exiled to Baozhou.

units.zh: 以耶律化哥譖，出為南京兵馬副元帥，守太尉，更王隋。
units.en: Because of Yelu Huage's slander he was sent out as Deputy Marshal of the Southern Capital armies and horses, held the office of Defender Grandee, and was reassigned as Prince of Sui.
units.literal: Because of Yelu Huage's slander, he was sent out as Deputy Marshal of the Southern Capital armies and horses, held the office of Defender Grandee, and was reassigned as Prince of Sui.

units.zh: 尋遣蕭達魯古、撒把害太子。
units.en: Soon afterward Xiao Dalugu and Saba were dispatched to murder the crown prince.
units.literal: Soon Xiao Dalugu and Saba were sent to harm the crown prince.
